closed: ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 14)) (hdeg : ∀ v : Fin 14, 4 ≤ Nat.card (G.neighborSet v)) (hq : Nat.card (Gᶜ).edgeSet ≤ 15), x2611_15358_D G ≤ x2611_15358_N G 1 + x2611_15358_N G 2 + x2611_15358_N G 3
original:
In a disconnected graph on seven vertices, every component other than a chosen largest component has at most three vertices.
For $k=1,2,3$ , let $N_{k}$ count all occurrences of a component of size $k$ in the graphs $G[U]$ , over all $U$ with $|U|=7$ .
Thus $D\leq N_{1}+N_{2}+N_{3}$ .
